title: Predicate conformance case
description: One case: a named predicate, its input, and the result it must produce. Both predicates are pure functions of their input, so one runner serves both — it reads `predicate`, calls the named function, and compares.

predicate.description: Which predicate this case drives. Carried in the case rather than only in the index so a case file is self-describing.

input.description: isHitlRequest only. Any JSON value, including null — the predicate is total, and several cases assert it rejects a non-object rather than failing.

tools.description: findRowDataTools only. The tool surface under test. Entries are deliberately unconstrained: cases assert that a candidate whose name is not a string is skipped rather than flagged or fatal.

violations.description: findRowDataTools only. Every offending tool, in INPUT order — not sorted. A tool list is an ordered sequence every language iterates identically, so preserving that order pins more than sorting would. At most one entry per candidate.

tool.description: The offending tool's name, verbatim — not folded.

segment.description: The matched segment from docs/spec/predicates/v1/row-data-segments.json. The FIRST match in name order, not in set order.
